answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 31677 Country: Pakistan Title: Is it right to offer namaz janaza in masjid or it is against the sharia. Question: Is it right to offer namaz janaza in masjid or it is against the sharia. Answer ID: 31677 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 618/517/B=1432) It is makrooh to perform funeral Salah in mosque: وکرھت تحریما وقیل تنزیھا فی مسجد جماعۃ الخ (الدر المختار) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
